Maya: Quick question 1 1 about promo timing for APAC folks — are we using payroll month boundaries or the approval date?
Ravi: For this round we aim for month boundary effective dates. If approvals hit before payroll cutoff they take effect the 1st of next month.
Maya: And cutoff is the usual end-of-month payroll file submission time? any hard UTC?
Ravi: Yes 1 payroll cutoff is 2026-05-25 18:00 UTC for APAC-inclusive run. Approvals after that will be retroed but go through exception path.
Karen: What's the typical retro timeline for base pay? will managers see a one-off in their people reports?
Ravi: Retro (backpay) is calculated to the effective date and paid out in the subsequent payroll cycle. It shows on the employee's paystub as an adjustment. Reporting will reflect in compensation exports the cycle after payout.
Maya: How about equity grant timing if promotion is mid-cycle? do we prorate target or wait for next grant window?
Karen: Equity follows equity ops rules 1 generally we schedule grants in next grant window and note prorated targets in the approval comments. If manager requests immediate grant, escalate to Equity Ops with case details.
PeopleOps Bot: Heads up 1 exception requests require People Ops + Manager Exec signoff. Use form: https://redwood.company/internal/promo-exceptions
Maya: If a role change is lateral but compensation bump is for market adjustment, do we still use the promo flow or a comp adjustment request?
Ravi: Use "Comp Change" flow for market adjustments (not leveling). That route keeps leveling data clean. Attach market comp rationale and benchmark source.
Karen: One more 1 hybrid/matrix roles: include a 1-line corroboration from the partner manager in the evidence field to avoid delays.
Maya: Great, thanks. I'll ping my managers with the exact cutoff and the comp-change vs promo guidance.
